title: Counterexamples to the duality conjecture for metric entropy

abstractEnglish: We disprove Pietsch's dimension-free duality conjecture for metric entropy. For every proposed pair of universal constants, we construct origin-symmetric convex bodies that violate the corresponding covering-entropy inequality, already when the covering body is a cube.
